task.title: The "Adding to" input on the Catalog is not rendering the selection correctly
task.description: When I click the "Adding to" input on the Catalog page to change it from the default of Inbox, it seems to be rendering outside the view frame, I just see a slim gray bar above the picker suggesting the bottom of a selection box. Then when I click away, there is a brief flash of content that causes the page to rerender (the grid of cards is briefly pushed down).
